notes.title: Announcing Lazy Galaxy 2!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Coldwild Games is happy to announce a direct sequel to Lazy Galaxy game, called, *drumroll*, Lazy Galaxy 2. Yup, you've heard it right. We've taken the name of the first game and added "2" besides it.

You can check it out here: 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/[/url]

What can you expect from it? Glad you asked!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27023349/e52bc5479658523608a8bc046a61d2d42ce250e6.gif[/img]

Lazy Galaxy 2 is an idle/clicker game with base-building and RTS elements. Lead an evil (albeit lazy) alien race to conquer the universe! Expand your base, fight vicious foes, and conquer the galaxies. Acquire combat experience and convert into candy, the most precious alien resource!

It tries to expand upon Lazy Galaxy 1 formula by adding maps/spatial conquest, paired with pre-built player campaigns and greatly enhanced basebuilding system. You don't even need to play the first game to enjoy it. 

Lazy Galaxy 2 is a game that you can run minimized while watching your favourite Netflix show. Build the base, check out the universe map and send your fleets to start the conquest. No micro-transactions are planned, the game is a single-player premium, pay-once, keep-clicking-forever title.

Wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477950/Lazy_Galaxy_2/[/url]

notes.title: Further plans & New Game Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Great news! We're working on a new game in Lazy Galaxy universe.

Here's the steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/533050/Lazy_Galaxy_Rebel_Story/

It's going to be a shoot-em-up roguelite, where you take the other side of the conflict and try to destroy O'Xelg base.

An old robot named H-34-RT wakes up in a derelict space station orbiting his home planet. His civilization was destroyed long ago by evil O'Xelg, but he has yet to figure that out. After an initial shock, he decides to follow his old defense routines: that means fighting the invaders, even if he is alone now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/6596ea3db71b62335116bddbd26908d5b480a62d.png[/img]

The idea is that you control a fleet of up to 3 fighters rather than one, this will allow you to switch formations to better avoid enemy fire or focus yours.

The game will feature rogue-lite systems (you'll pick the permanent bonuses that boost your ship during the walkthrough) and multiple possible weapons that you can pick during the level.

Apart from that: we're still going to support this one, in fact there's a small patch coming out next week. :)

Stay tuned for more news!
Best,
Vladimir

notes.title: Lazy Galaxy is released! 1.0 Release patchnotes
notes.content:
Great news! After multiple patches, addition of mods, items, crafting, star system conquest and new game+ modes, Lazy Galaxy goes into full release, together with its final big content patch!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/9398ff1960a82e63501443245163935b07d54b7f.jpg[/img]

- Clans: similar to guilds, you can only select one. There are three guilds now: space engineers, warrior's league, brotherhood of relics. In addition to bonuses, the clans have their own drawbacks. You can combine them with guilds to see what works best!
[list]
[*]Space Engineers focus on quality ship building and item crafting. They provide boosts for tier 2 buildings.
[*]Brotherhood of Relics offers increased relic productivity and moves a limit on building multiple relics, but it comes at a cost of spaceport.
[*]Warrior's League focuses on combat, offering big boosts to ship health and damage but sacrificing scientific gains in the process.
[/list]

- Building Templates: Save your current base build and quick-build it in the next galaxy
- Item stacking: Items now stack into stacks of 99

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/67659714922b89c87dacc06dd567f308134769de.png[/img]

- Cooking: Can SHIFT+CLICK on an item to add up to 3 items from the same item stack
- Cooking: Added recipe book of items, that you discovered/crafted
- Cooking: Can select recipe to use ingredients of the highest possible level
- Cooking: Space Oven levels have a bigger effect on crafting speed
- Modding: Added ability to add your own supply boxes for your items
- General battle rewards will be automatically collected when jumping to next stars/galaxies
- Generals can be bought right after new game+ (if you can afford 'em)
- Item bonuses' summary will be now formatted according to notation settings

- Options: Keep building mode ON after placing a building, so you don't have to click "Build" button again
- Options: Start each space battle with open ship panels, that are closed, once battle starts
- Options: Screen Shake slider
- Options: Some of the options can now be changed during space battle
- Bugfix: Cooking timer will show after a timeout, if inventory is resorted (or lootboxes opened) after starting a craft, but before the timer shows up
- Bugfix: Custom fleets and generals should be available in first galaxy after starting new game+
- Bugfix: Offline progress will be properly calculated when returning from Mod menu
- Bugfix: Fixed FPS limiting option; it now should limit FPS properly (when minimized)
- Bugfix: Fixed the number of exp required for next candy
- Balance: increased space oven efficiency by 40% when it comes to calculating crafting speed
- Balance: scavenger starport bonus decreased from 10% per level to 5%
- Music: Two new tracks, one for battle, one for base

I think this concludes the large content updates for the game. From now on, we're moving to bugfixing mode :) Our plans might change because of the release. 
Thanks for supporting us through the early access and if you want to continue getting news from us (once in two-three months) - sign up for our newsletter [url=http://eepurl.com/cYW9x1]here[/url].

If you want to support us further - leave a review, spread the word, this will help us _enormously_.

As usual - should you have any questions, you are more than welcome to join our discord channel.
Cheers,
Vladimir

Great news! After multiple patches, addition of mods, items, crafting, star system conquest and new game+ modes, Lazy Galaxy goes into full release, together with its final big content patch!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/9398ff1960a82e63501443245163935b07d54b7f.jpg[/img]

- Clans: similar to guilds, you can only select one. There are three guilds now: space engineers, warrior's league, brotherhood of relics. In addition to bonuses, the clans have their own drawbacks. You can combine them with guilds to see what works best!
[list]
[*]Space Engineers focus on quality ship building and item crafting. They provide boosts for tier 2 buildings.
[*]Brotherhood of Relics offers increased relic productivity and moves a limit on building multiple relics, but it comes at a cost of spaceport.
[*]Warrior's League focuses on combat, offering big boosts to ship health and damage but sacrificing scientific gains in the process.
[/list]

- Building Templates: Save your current base build and quick-build it in the next galaxy
- Item stacking: Items now stack into stacks of 99

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/67659714922b89c87dacc06dd567f308134769de.png[/img]

- Cooking: Can SHIFT+CLICK on an item to add up to 3 items from the same item stack
- Cooking: Added recipe book of items, that you discovered/crafted
- Cooking: Can select recipe to use ingredients of the highest possible level
- Cooking: Space Oven levels have a bigger effect on crafting speed
- Modding: Added ability to add your own supply boxes for your items
- General battle rewards will be automatically collected when jumping to next stars/galaxies
- Generals can be bought right after new game+ (if you can afford 'em)
- Item bonuses' summary will be now formatted according to notation settings

- Options: Keep building mode ON after placing a building, so you don't have to click "Build" button again
- Options: Start each space battle with open ship panels, that are closed, once battle starts
- Options: Screen Shake slider
- Options: Some of the options can now be changed during space battle
- Bugfix: Cooking timer will show after a timeout, if inventory is resorted (or lootboxes opened) after starting a craft, but before the timer shows up
- Bugfix: Custom fleets and generals should be available in first galaxy after starting new game+
- Bugfix: Offline progress will be properly calculated when returning from Mod menu
- Bugfix: Fixed FPS limiting option; it now should limit FPS properly (when minimized)
- Bugfix: Fixed the number of exp required for next candy
- Balance: increased space oven efficiency by 40% when it comes to calculating crafting speed
- Balance: scavenger starport bonus decreased from 10% per level to 5%
- Music: Two new tracks, one for battle, one for base

I think this concludes the large content updates for the game. From now on, we're moving to bugfixing mode :) Our plans might change because of the release. 
Thanks for supporting us through the early access and if you want to continue getting news from us (once in two-three months) - sign up for our newsletter [url=http://eepurl.com/cYW9x1]here[/url].

If you want to support us further - leave a review, spread the word, this will help us _enormously_.

As usual - should you have any questions, you are more than welcome to join our discord channel.
Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.title: Lazy Galaxy Early Access Patch 1.5 - Autocombat + Ship Mod Support!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

At last, we are ready to publish the latest Lazy Galaxy changes!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EmpZWaxaeOw

[h1]General and automatic combat[/h1]
First of all, we're super excited to introduce the new general system!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/b3c1c23c7fc9197aa3d2ef42e3f57ec0b15e5912.png[/img]

After conquering two galaxies, you will be able to send the general to fight in your place. As usual, build your fleet, click on the point that you want to conquer, but this time there will be a choice that allows to send the general instead of you.

Your ship is taken away to power the general army, you stay on your base screen while general fights and gathers rewards. You can then collect by simply clicking the reward button on star map!

[h1]Mod Support[/h1]

After that - there's a ship modding support, which essentially allows you to add custom ships to the game :) Set up your weapons / hulls / prices and put your own sci-fi ships into the game! You can find out more in our [url=http://lazygalaxy.wikia.com/wiki/Modding_Guide]wiki[/url].

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
Finally, this marks the last serious content patch. We're going to release the game on March 22, and during these two weeks before release we'll be doing more polishing / ui improvements and minor feature adjustments.

If you like the game - please leave a positive review, those things really help during release. Even one or two lines tremendously help the game get noticed.

[h1]Full changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] After conquering your first galaxy, you will be able to pick your own fleet with each jump! If you are not fighting - you can send out your general to do the job for you.
[*] Modding: Ship validation & submission
[*] Modding: Tags will be automatically assigned to mods based on contents when uploading/updating
[*] Modding: You can now write change log for your mod updates inside the game
[*] Modding: You can choose not to update mod description, when submitting an update. That's in case if you had a good description that you wrote outside the game (e.g. in steam client)
[*] Added setting to disable/enable damage text in battles (better performance? no promises?)
[*] Fixed bug that used wrong items after sorting

Thanks for being awesome and as usual, if you have any questions - do join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/013oJVAEt1l3JM1wC]discord channel[/url]!

notes.title: Lazy Galaxy Early Access Patch 1.3 is out - Item System / Crafting!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've baked a new patch!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/67659714922b89c87dacc06dd567f308134769de.png[/img]

Coldwild Games is happy to bring you the next major patch in our early access series :)

This time we're adding an item / crafting system and various optimizations. Let's start from the crafting.

[h1]We got a new building![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/62cac43f56410c13f8b0fe11e976b5a18a4ee611.png[/img]
It's called "Space Oven." It's used for cooking awesome stuff. You can upgrade it to cook even faster, but it's quite costly (both in upgrade price and energy consumption).

Finally, you can click on it or on your inventory button to start the crafting process. The Space Oven becomes available on third star system.

[h1]The cooking process itself[/h1]

The cooking works in two ways: first, you can combine three similar items to get a stronger one [b]OR[/b] you can try combining three different items to see. The recipes are left for you to discover, but we might make a wiki later on :)

There are total 28 new items in this patch. Those items give you permanent boosts that affect your building production, ship damage and strength, offline production, species growth and battle rewards.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/c582d100c4c6c32802db555e71e304f0600f5d03.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/4c6daaa0714ff82c6b548df0dc3520dd28b59e8e.png[/img][/url]
Inventory Screen

[h1]Balance[/h1]
Thanks to your feedback, we know that increasing the amout of star systems to beat the galaxy made the game feel grindy. Now each galaxy has 5 systems that needs to be conquered, but the enemies encountered will be considerably tougher (base level grows). 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TuNcBq53H0U

[h1]User Experience[/h1]
A lot of effort went into improving the user experience. Bullet / damage text were optimized to work much faster, so your average performance should improve greatly.

The statistics window has also been added to show your progress / total numbers in the game.

We've also received a lot of reports on occasional crashes. We're sorry that they were happening: we've analyzed them and those seem to be results of internal workings of unity engine (to which we don't have any access). We've updated the unity version and the crashes did not occur on our side anymore, but let us know if this continues to happen and we'll be monitoring the situation closely.

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Building: Space Oven, allows you to craft the items! Becomes available in third galaxy
[*] Crafting system: combine 3 same items to get improved item or experiment with combining the items together!
[*] 28 new items added
[*] Asteroid Map Points grant supply boxes upon completing; player can pick one item from them to boost his stats
[*] Sabre Weapon Damage Type changed to heat
[*] Made Trader offline bonus stack multiplicatively with the rest production bonuses
[*] Statistics Window
[*] Fixed Player Damage/HP multipliers: they no longer apply to enemy ships
[*] Galaxy Jumps now award candy too
[*] Fixed wrong discount that was applied to ship ugrades from blessings
[*] Candy amount gained from candy boxes in space battles is scaled with the current level of an encounter
[*] Candy is formatted like any other resouce
[*] Candy tooltip is updated every second when moused over
[*] Ship health bar dissappears, when ship gets destroyed or ship's health reaches 0
[*] Frame limiting option in background mode
[*] Performance impact of damage text in battles is reduced
[*] Bullet/projectile instantiation rework, should improve performance / memory handling
[/list]

[h1]Thanks for your support![/h1]
We appreciate all the feedback that you send us in :) The next patch will work on mod support; If you encounter any errors - please let us know in discussion forums or join [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/013oJVAEt1l3JM1wC]our discord channel![/url]

notes.title: Devlog 07 - Deeper look into upcoming item system
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Due to the big scope of the task, there won't be a patch this week. We simply want to work out the item system completely before pushing it to live version.

We do have a more detailed overview on how items are going to work:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zkQgRlz_AOk

To make it short:
- You will be able to get supply crates from the battles. From these supply crates, you will be able to select one item of your choice (the item that you need the most)
- Combining three items of same level produces more powerful item of the next level
- There are some hidden recipes that you can try and figure out by experimenting with item combinations :)

Cheers and we're really excited to bring you the item system next week.
Vladimir

notes.title: Save Issue / in case your save file disappeared after 1.2 patch
notes.content:
We are aware that some save files could have been corrupted after patch and there's a hotfix for that (you are safe to launch the game now - it shouldn't happen anymore). 

However, you'll need to manually do the following things to restore your save if it crashed before: 

To restore your save on windows: 

[olist]
[*]On windows, open any folder paste "%APPDATA%/../LocalLow/ColdwildGames/LazyGalaxy" into address line (without quotes) and press enter this should open it 
[*]there should be a file like session.sav1.bak 
[*]if you see it: delete the file session.sav nearby 
[*]rename session.sav1.bak into session.sav 

Launch the latest version of the game - the save should work now. If it does not - drop me an email to contact(at)coldwild.com or message me directly in discord and I'll help you to resolve it. Thanks for your patience and I'm sorry this happened!﻿

notes.title: Early Access patch 1.2 - Game Ending / Hard Reset mechanics!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! You've mentioned the resource gain slowing down later on in the game, as well as the need for hard-reset mechanics (lose all the candy, gain cool bonus). 

Well, we're happy to say that this patch starts addressing those comments. New Game+ mode is going to be there for hardcore players, while simple game ending will give you a chance to complete the universal conquest :)

Here's the video of me explaining the changes and the reasoning behind them: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9UQ4EPuDEF4

[list]
[*]New Game+ mode (you can actually complete the game now!), which allows you to reset your progress and gain a permanent powerful boost (they stack if you complete the game multiple times!)
[*]Ship Selection is saved across battles
[*]AutoPurchase Reworked: can now arrange the specific number of ships purchased
[*]Galactic Map introduced (shown between galactic jumps, informative screen that adds importance to this process)
[*]Building Multipliers introduced: special researches that multiply total building production by a constant number
[/list]

Here's one of the blessings after game completion:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013685/6366d24955385a67ccc399303c46b5983e591e5e.png[/img]

Obviously, this is quite a big patch, and even though we've tested it extensively - some issues might arise. I'm here to address them ASAP, should you notice something wrong.

Please consider leaving a positive review if you like the game or join or [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/013oJVAEt1l3JM1wC]discord community[/url] to tell me your thoughts in case you feel that something's wrong.

Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.content:

[*] Reduced Tasty Conquest upgrade costs (was impossible to get with normal resource gains)
[*] Destroying enemy ships give you basic reward of 20 metal and 15 fuel per destroyed ship level
[/list]

We know that at one point the costs become too prohibitive, but it's better than allowing crashes late-game. We're going to address this with the next big content update.

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.0.4 - Weapon Types!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Judging by feedback so far, I've decided to adjust the ship balance (reducing enemy damage a bit, while buffing the bosses in later game).

This patch introduces ship damage: ship weapons have a type now, and that type deals different damage to different types of armor. You will be able to check its description in the ship info panel. This shouldn't disturb late-game idle gameplay too much, but the strategic gameplay at the beginning of the game should make the game feel fairer and allow players to find right ship combinations to deal with specific enemy (mostly boss) threats.

I'm also tackling the different bug reports. Without further ado, here goes the list:
[list]
[*] steam achievements for the amount of bosses killed should work now
[*] adjusted enemy dreadnought rocket launcher position
[*] graphics: slightly randomized laser hit position (they don't hit enemy center only anymore)
[*] damage types: weapons perform differently vs different kinds of armor
[*] reduced the size of damage text (since there's so much of it)
[*] bosses are not going to collide into you and instantly take out one of your ships
[*] friagtes are going to be stronger (increased bullet damage by 50%, laser damage by 100%)
[*] dreadnoughts are going to be weaker (decreased rocket damage by 50%)
[*] fixed the bug when intergalactic cannon appeared only after finishing the first star system of any galaxy (should now appear when you clear the second star system for the first time)
[*] ship info panel will now show limited info on ship weapons: the weapon type (you'll see the stats if you hover on it) and the dps
[*] showing ability hotkey near ability name in combat
[*] showing simple tooltip when hovering on ship selection panel in combat
[*] can open enemy / friendly ship info by right-clicking on ship selection panel

Thank you for playing and keep being awesome! Let me know if you have any other comments.
Cheers,
Vladimir

notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thanks to your feedback, I understand that there are later-game balancing issues + some unexpected crashes (with no progress being saved). That sucks and I'm tryint go address it as fast as I can. Here's what I changed with this patch:

[list]
[*] AutoSaves every 2 minutes
[*] Balancing: increased player ship hp; this is a start of a larger balancing fix (it's clear that late-game needs a rebalance): right now the 25-level-health-multiplier increased to 2, enemy 25-level-damage multipliers are also getting closer to 2 (reduced dramatically from 3 and 4). [*] As a temporary solution, the buildings affected by "Base Clicker" spawn small "red lightning" particles to indicate that they are currently affected
[*] "Purchased All Available Upgrades" won't lag so much anymore
[*] Base clicker description fix: works for 20 seconds instead of 10 seconds (I don't want you to be clicking on this stuff to death, people)
[*] Ship Level is shown in hangar (but no "dismiss" button yet - work in progress).
[/list]

I'm aware that some people experience crashes after hours of idling: I'll keep looking into that. If you expect a game crash while having it open for multiple hours - do let me know. Thanks for your feedback!

I'm going to take a few hours off to visit my parents, but I'll be back soon to monitor the situation closely.
Thanks,
Vladimir

notes.title: Lazy Galaxy - Devlog #15
notes.content:
Hey! :) I've been doing the devlogs on my personal youtube channel, but since the Steam page went live - I think it's a good idea if I describe what has been done recently to keep you all updated!

This week was mostly spent polishing / balancing the battles. There were new ability animations, but the biggest achievement this week was actually figuring out the solution on how the battles should work.

The thing is: the battles were very short, which is great if you are looking mostly for idle experience, but they felt a bit awkward if you were looking for tactical experience where you'd heal, use abilities, evade projectiles. There's not much tactics if shot exchange instantly ends within 2 seconds with most of the ships dead.

To fix that: I've added a special value that determines if player wants to fight longer or have more of an idle experience. It's a simple slider in settings, all that it does is multiplies the hp of BOTH sides by a selected value from 1 to 5. Since the damage remains the same, the battles can become significantly longer, where skill will matter much more: the more projectiles you will dodge, the more health boxes you will be able to collect and prolong your starfighting experience.

Here's the further video with explanation if you want to see how it works in action:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E_q_BTdx-Kg

Thanks for reading and stay tuned for weekly updates (and, of course, the release on Dec 15 :)

Cheers,
Vladimir
